storage: Whole and unwashed in the fridge vegetable drawer, loosely wrapped or in a paper bag, for about a week. Keep it away from ripening fruit such as bananas and tomatoes, which make it yellow and soften faster. Cut cucumber: cover the cut face and use within 1–2 days. Chop it just before serving the chaat, because chopped cucumber releases water and makes the chaat soggy.
